name: Draft replies to restaurant reviews with OpenAI and approve them in a form

parameters.content:
## Draft replies to restaurant reviews with OpenAI and approve them in a form

For restaurant owners and managers who want help writing review replies without handing over control. Paste a review into a form and the AI drafts an on-brand reply. You check it, edit it and copy it. **Nothing is posted automatically.**

### How it works
1. Open the **Add a Review** form (only signed-in n8n users can open it). Paste the reviewer's name, the star rating and the review text.
2. **Prepare Review** flags sensitive topics: illness, allergies, legal threats, refunds and prompt-injection attempts.
3. The AI drafts a short reply in your brand voice with your sign-off.
4. **Check Draft** flags offers of refunds or freebies, staff names, last names, argumentative wording and a missing sign-off.
5. A review page shows the draft in an editable box together with the flags. Choose **Use this reply** to get a clean copy to paste on Google, Yelp or Facebook, or discard it.

### Setup (about 10 minutes)
1. In **Settings**, set your restaurant name, brand voice, sign-off and contact line.
2. Add your OpenAI credential to **OpenAI Chat Model**. Any OpenAI-compatible provider also works.
3. Publish, then bookmark the form's production URL.

### Requirements
n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) and an OpenAI API key (pay per use, about one short request per review).

### Good to know
Tested on self-hosted n8n 2.40 with a small local model; not yet tested on n8n Cloud or with OpenAI models. Drafts can contain mistakes, such as offering a refund, which is why you approve every reply yourself.

A fuller paid version adds CSV upload, forwarded-email intake, email approvals and a weekly summary (link on my creator profile).

## 1. Review in, AI draft out
You paste the review. The AI writes a draft in your voice, and the draft is checked for risky wording.

## 2. You decide
Edit the draft, then use it or discard it. You post it yourself.
